child_list.content: The ugly duckling
child_list.name: 题目

elements.content: A mother duck sat in the nest and waited for her babies to hatch. Later, the baby ducks came out of their shells one by one. The mother duck was very happy to see her babies except the ugly one. All ducks laughed at the ugly duckling. He had to run away from home. The ugly duckling grew up day by day. One day, he saw a group of beautiful swans swimming on a lake. He swam to these swans. The ugly duckling saw himself in the water. He was no longer an ugly duck. He became a beautiful swan.

child_list.content: 丑小鸭
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
鸭妈妈坐在窝里等着她的宝宝孵出来。

后来，小鸭子一个接一个地从壳里出来了。鸭妈妈很高兴看到她的孩子们，除了那只丑的。所有的鸭子都嘲笑这只丑小鸭。他不得不离家出走。丑小鸭一天天长大了。 一天，他看见一群美丽的天鹅在湖上游泳。他游向这些天鹅。丑小鸭看见自己在水里的倒影。他不再是一只丑小鸭了。他变成了一只美丽的天鹅。

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
